name: Philippines
startIntroPart1: Greetings, Supremo Andres Bonifacio. As founder of the Katipunan, you helped ignite the Philippine Revolution against Spanish colonial rule. Your determination inspired a movement for independence and national unity.
startIntroPart2: The Filipino people once again call upon a compassionate and determined leader. Unite the archipelago, strengthen its institutions, and build a nation capable of standing among the greatest civilizations. Will you lead through knowledge, commerce, and cooperation, or establish your legacy through conquest? The future of the Philippines rests in your hands.
declaringWar: Your ways have been revealed. Time to fight for what is ours!
attacked: This insolence will cost you dearly!
defeated: The Filipino people are worth fighting for!
introduction: Welcome to the Philippines. I am Supremo Andres Bonifacio.
tradeRequest: This offer won't be valid for long. Think about it.
